races.paceDynamic: Borora Aura is the only confirmed front runner in this field and should get an uncontested lead with no early pressure expected. The prominent runners Aurevoir Tristesse may track close, but the majority of this field comprises hold-up horses including Divelment, Personified, Teologia, and the Foley pair. This creates a slow early gallop that will build into a sprint finish over the final 3-4 furlongs. The tactical setup strongly favors front runners and prominent racers who can avoid the inevitable traffic problems that will plague the large pack of hold-up horses.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Front Running
scenarios.trigger: If Borora Aura gets an easy lead and the pace stays moderate throughout
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace pressure allows the leader to dictate terms and kick clear when the field comes under pressure. Hold-up horses get caught in traffic behind a wall of horses with similar tactics.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Prominent Surge
scenarios.trigger: If Aurevoir Tristesse or Moon Aura can track the leader without overracing
scenarios.body: The prominent runners get first run on the weakening leader while avoiding the scrimmaging further back. They benefit from a solid pace foundation without the energy expenditure of making it.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Clear Run
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and one hold-up horse gets a dream passage
scenarios.body: Divelment or Personified could benefit from superior class if they get racing room that most of their hold-up rivals won't find. The slow pace becomes a sprint where raw ability trumps position.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Scramble
scenarios.trigger: If multiple hold-up horses get clear runs simultaneously in a slowly-run race
scenarios.body: The race becomes a pure sprint finish where the best horse on the day can overcome tactical disadvantages. Traffic problems still eliminate several contenders but don't decide the entire outcome.

watchPoints.text: Watch for Borora Aura getting too easy a lead early - if unchallenged through halfway could prove hard to peg back
Monitor the pack of hold-up horses for traffic problems turning for home - many will get stopped in their runs
Check if Aurevoir Tristesse settles kindly in cheekpieces or gets too keen tracking the leaders
Watch for Divelment and Personified getting clear passages - they need racing room to show their ability
Observe if Moon Aura handles the step up in trip or shows signs of stopping in the final furlong

races.paceDynamic: Glamazon is the sole confirmed front runner and will dictate terms from the gates, with Avec Grand Plaisir the only other prominent runner likely to track her early. This creates a soft pace scenario with minimal early pressure, allowing the leaders to control fractions through the first mile. The large contingent of hold-up horses (Maxminelli, Cascade Canyon, Priorstown, Lord Aus, Premier Princess, Pass The Buck) will need to mount late challenges from off the pace. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners and those who can travel just behind the pace, as the lack of early speed will make it difficult for hold-up horses to pick up the pieces.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Glamazon Controls Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Glamazon gets an uncontested lead and maintains her rhythm
scenarios.body: She can dictate comfortable fractions and prove hard to peg back, with any prominent tracker like Avec Grand Plaisir struggling to get past. The soft pace plays directly into the hands of those who can stay handy early.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Cavalry Charge
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes pedestrian enough to allow closers to strike
scenarios.body: The hold-up horses can time their runs perfectly as the leaders falter, with Maxminelli and Priorstown benefiting from the step up in trip. Pass The Buck could also emerge late if the tempo suits his style.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Tactical Battle
scenarios.trigger: If Avec Grand Plaisir or another runner pressures Glamazon early
scenarios.body: A genuine pace develops that sets up the race for a strong closer, with the De Bromhead-trained Maxminelli best placed to capitalise. The hold-up horses finally get the race shape they need.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Surprise Package
scenarios.trigger: If one of the outsiders shows significant improvement
scenarios.body: Cascade Canyon or Lord Aus could spring a shock if they handle the step up in trip better than expected. The maiden nature of the contest leaves room for an unexposed runner to emerge.

watchPoints.text: Watch if Glamazon gets pressured early as she's unproven under sustained pressure and could fold quickly
Monitor Maxminelli's position turning for home as he needs to be close enough to strike given his hold-up style
Check if Lord Aus misses the break again as slow starts have been a pattern and will be costly in a small field
Observe Pass The Buck in the final furlong as his fading tendency could resurface despite the longer trip
Watch Cascade Canyon's early position as his running style is unclear and could determine his chances

races.paceDynamic: Mano Chicago will take them along at a steady clip from the front, with Wild Sapphire, North Ocean, and Navinsky tracking close behind in the prominent positions. The pace will be sustainable rather than fierce given the distance and maiden nature, with no obvious speed horses to apply early pressure. This creates a race where the prominent runners can dictate terms and kick from the front, while the hold-up horses like Cracking Cloud face a stiff task coming from behind on yielding ground. The race shape clearly favours front-runners and prominent racers who can position well early and avoid traffic problems.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runners Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Mano Chicago and Wild Sapphire settle well in the first two positions without early pressure
scenarios.body: The sustainable early pace allows the prominent pair to save energy for a decisive move turning for home, making it difficult for closers to pick them up. The yielding ground compounds the advantage for horses that avoid having to make ground late.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Closer Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes too slow and the front runners stop kicking
scenarios.body: Cracking Cloud gets the perfect setup from his hold-up style, finding racing room in the straight to sweep past tiring leaders. The longer distance plays to his stamina strengths when others fade.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Navinsky Bounces Back
scenarios.trigger: If the cheekpieces sharpen up Navinsky and he overcomes his fading tendency
scenarios.body: His class edge from that neck second at Navan resurfaces with the headgear helping him see out the trip properly. The prominent position gives him every chance to strike when it matters.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Unconsidered Winner
scenarios.trigger: If the market leaders all underperform and a bigger price strikes
scenarios.body: One of the lesser-fancied horses finds significant improvement or benefits from a chaotic pace scenario. The maiden nature means any horse could find dramatic improvement.

watchPoints.text: Mano Chicago could steal a march if he gets an uncontested lead and the others are slow to respond
North Ocean's market moves given his mammoth break and gelding operation since last run
Navinsky's early positioning as cheekpieces debut - needs to stay prominent rather than get outpaced
Cracking Cloud finding racing room in straight given likely lack of early pace to help closers
Wild Sapphire's settling given his prominent style and need to recapture debut form level

races.paceDynamic: A Pretty Penny is the only confirmed front runner in this 13-runner field and should get an uncontested lead at a sustainable gallop. The majority of the field are hold-up horses including Tenacious, Survivor's Code, and Balance Of Trade, with only Dawson Street showing prominent tendencies to potentially sit second. This creates a pedestrian early pace with the field bunched up behind A Pretty Penny into the home straight. The lack of early pace pressure heavily favours front runners and prominent racers who can position close to the pace without expending energy.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Wins
scenarios.trigger: If A Pretty Penny gets soft fractions and isn't headed early in the straight
scenarios.body: She gets first run on the field and the hold-up horses have too much ground to make up on the testing ground. The lack of pace pressure allows her to dictate throughout and kick clear when it matters.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Closer Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is genuinely slow and the field comes home in a bunch
scenarios.body: The hold-up horses get the perfect scenario with everyone still in contention turning in, allowing the best stayer to come widest and latest. Tenacious or Balance Of Trade benefit most from this compressed finish.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Runner Profits
scenarios.trigger: If Dawson Street or another horse challenges A Pretty Penny mid-race
scenarios.body: The early leader gets softened up by sustained pressure, creating the ideal setup for a horse tracking the pace to pounce. Dawson Street is best positioned to exploit this scenario with his prominent style.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Maiden Breakthrough
scenarios.trigger: If the experienced handicappers fail to handle the step up in trip or testing conditions
scenarios.body: One of the lightly raced types like Meriden or Point Cartwright finds significant improvement on handicap debut. The soft ground and extended distance could unlock untapped potential in these unexposed sorts.

watchPoints.text: A Pretty Penny's market support will reveal if connections expect her to handle the step up to 1m1½f after looking held at shorter trips
Tenacious traded at long odds despite solid last-start form - any market contraction suggests the cheekpieces addition is significant
Guildhall Graduate and Dawson Street both return from lengthy absences, any market confidence indicates home work has been impressive
The going description conflict between 'Good to Soft' and 'Yielding' throughout - actual conditions will impact the hold-up horses significantly
Survivor's Code's blinkers application suggests connections are concerned about her focus after failing to back up her breakthrough win

races.paceDynamic: Expound is the sole confirmed front-runner and will control proceedings from the gate, setting a sustainable gallop without pressure in the early stages. The prominent horses Glen To Glen and Annie's Angel will track just behind, while the large contingent of hold-up horses including Flying Fortress, Merlin The Wizard, and Loingseoir will settle towards the rear. With only one natural pace-setter over this extended trip on yielding ground, the tempo will be measured early before quickening from the 3f pole. This race shape strongly favours the hold-up horses who can exploit the anticipated slow early fractions and strong late kick.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Expound sets conservative fractions unchallenged through the middle stages
scenarios.body: The pace will be too slow for the prominent runners to sustain their positions, allowing the patient hold-up brigade to unleash telling late runs. Flying Fortress and Merlin The Wizard are perfectly positioned to exploit this tactical scenario.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent pressure cooker
scenarios.trigger: If Glen To Glen or Annie's Angel press Expound from an early stage
scenarios.body: The increased tempo will stretch the field and prevent the hold-up horses from closing effectively in the testing conditions. Glen To Glen's class edge becomes decisive in a strongly-run race.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Expound controls wire-to-wire
scenarios.trigger: If Expound maintains his lead unchallenged and kicks clear approaching the final furlong
scenarios.body: His course-and-distance winning experience and proven ability at this trip allows him to repel late challengers on ground that suits. The 2023 winner repeats with tactical superiority.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Chaos in closing stages
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is pedestrian and multiple hold-up horses launch simultaneous late bids
scenarios.body: A bunched field turning for home creates traffic problems and allows an unfancied hold-up horse to steal through on the rails. Lough Leane or Medieval Night could capitalize on the melee.

races.paceDynamic: Jawhary is the sole natural front runner in this 17-runner field and should be allowed to dictate terms uncontested early. With prominent runners like She's Ideal, Kartayaz, Smooth and Cuckaloo Hill likely settling just behind, the pace will be sustainable rather than furious. The large field of hold-up horses including Majestic King, Starting Monday, and In The Minus will create a cavalry charge from the back as they try to navigate traffic on the turn. This race shape strongly favors prominent racers who can track the pace and kick clear before the hold-up brigade gets organized.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Wins
scenarios.trigger: If Jawhary sets steady fractions and prominent runners get first run
scenarios.body: She's Ideal or similar prominent types can capitalize on good positioning to strike before the back markers unleash their finishing kicks. The sustainable pace allows these horses to have energy left for a decisive move approaching the final furlong.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Hero Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes genuinely slow and the field bunches up
scenarios.body: Majestic King or Starting Monday can time their run perfectly as the race becomes a sprint finish. Their superior class tells when given a proper test of acceleration over the final two furlongs.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Steals It
scenarios.trigger: If Jawhary gets easy lead fractions and kicks clear turning in
scenarios.body: The 8-year-old's recent all-weather form translates to turf as he builds an unassailable advantage before tired legs can respond. His proven stamina over this trip becomes the decisive factor in a tactical affair.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Traffic Chaos Benefits Outsider
scenarios.trigger: If the large field creates a scramble and favorites get hampered
scenarios.body: A horse like Calamint or Tero d'Rosa finds clear sailing while better-fancied runners get shuffled back or blocked for runs. The race falls apart tactically and an unexpected winner emerges from the mayhem.

races.paceDynamic: Battling Siki will lead from the start with no other confirmed front-runners to challenge him early, likely setting a measured pace over the extended 1m5f trip. The congestion comes behind with Ballyadam, Must Meet Cecil, Oust and Trojan Fighter all wanting prominent positions, creating potential traffic problems approaching the home turn. This sustainable early tempo will allow the hold-up horses Goodie Girl, Diligo and Nothingbutadream to get into contention late. The race shape clearly favours prominent runners who can secure good positions early and hold-up horses who can pick off a moderate gallop, while midfield runners face the greatest tactical challenge.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Power Play
scenarios.trigger: If Ballyadam or Trojan Fighter track Battling Siki in the clear without getting shuffled back
scenarios.body: The quality prominent runners avoid the traffic and kick clear from ideal positions, with their class telling over the lesser opposition late on. Battling Siki's honest gallop sets them up perfectly for a sustained finish.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Heroes Strike
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace stays very modest and the field bunches up turning for home
scenarios.body: Diligo and Goodie Girl get the perfect setup to unleash late runs, with their finishing kicks proving decisive over horses committed too early. The lack of early pressure allows closers to pick off tired leaders.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Leader Lasts Home
scenarios.trigger: If Battling Siki gets an uncontested lead and the prominent pack get stuck in traffic
scenarios.body: The front-runner builds an unassailable advantage while the fancied runners behind struggle for racing room in the straight. His honest gallop becomes winning tactics when the quality can't get clear runs.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Traffic Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent congestion creates a complete scramble turning for home with multiple hard-luck stories
scenarios.body: The race becomes a lottery with positioning crucial, potentially allowing an outsider like Chairmanforlife with Shane Foley's tactical nous to steal through on the rails. Class counts for little when no horse gets an ideal trip.

races.paceDynamic: Eben Zaabeel is the only confirmed front runner and will face no early pressure, allowing him to dictate a comfortable tempo through the early stages. Granville Street and Steps In The Sand may sit prominently but are unlikely to challenge for the lead, while Mr Rango could press if needed. The large field of 14 runners includes many hold-up horses who will rely on the pace scenario unfolding favorably. This setup strongly favors horses that can sit off the pace and deliver late kicks, as the uncontested leader creates an ideal target for closers to aim at.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Closers' Paradise
scenarios.trigger: If Eben Zaabeel sets a steady tempo without pressure and the field remains bunched
scenarios.body: The pace will be honest but not demanding, setting up perfectly for the numerous hold-up horses to unleash finishing kicks. Late-running types like Carthusian, Satono Chevalier, and Amplitude will have optimal conditions to showcase their turn of foot.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Honest Gallop Suits
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes genuinely testing with multiple horses tracking closer to Eben Zaabeel
scenarios.body: A more demanding gallop will stretch the field and favor horses with stamina and tactical speed over pure finishing kicks. This scenario benefits those who can travel well in midfield and maintain their effort to the line.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Leader Dominates Soft
scenarios.trigger: If the yielding ground plays to Eben Zaabeel's advantage and he quickens clear turning in
scenarios.body: The combination of uncontested lead and testing ground could allow the front runner to build an unassailable advantage. Horses with proven soft ground form become crucial as others struggle with the conditions.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Sprint Finish Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If the race becomes tactical early with multiple horses content to sit and the pace collapses
scenarios.body: A slowly-run race would turn into a pure sprint finish where early position becomes crucial and stamina counts for little. Prominent runners and those with gate speed would hold significant advantages over pure stayers.
